scenes.say: Ever wonder how Python projects standardize their build and dependency setup? Why is pyproject.toml the new go-to?

scenes.label: Central
scenes.sub: pyproject.toml puts build, dependencies, and tool configs in one place.
scenes.say: pyproject.toml centralizes your build system, dependencies, and tool settings. No more scattered config files.
It replaces the old setup files, making packaging easier and more interoperable with tools like Poetry and uv.
Here’s a typical pyproject.toml. You define your project name, version, build system, and what tools you use.

scenes.question: Is setup.py required for new projects?
scenes.right: No, pyproject.toml fully replaces setup.py for modern packaging.
scenes.say: Don’t get caught thinking setup.py is still required. Modern projects use pyproject.toml instead.
